faults.what: Large gothic-looking pseudo-letters fill the page under the magnifying glass and are crisp enough to read as words.
faults.where: centre, inside the magnifier lens and the pages around it

faults.what: The young man walking out of the portal has no topknot, pale skin, a different face and dark grey trousers instead of jeans, and Usman beside M is a fluffy long-haired dog with both ears up, so neither reads as the same characters.
faults.where: left figure (Indio) and the dog at bottom centre-right

faults.what: Both open pages and the loose sheets are covered in rows of cursive pseudo-script with letter-like capitals.
faults.where: whole open book, left and right pages, loose sheet at bottom left
faults.must_fix_reason: The open manuscript fills the whole frame and the rows of fake cursive letters are sharp, so a paused viewer reads them as machine writing.

faults.what: The old brown book the teacher holds has a letter-like pseudo-title printed on its cover.
faults.where: book cover, lower right of centre
faults.second_reader: confirmed: the cover title is small and stays minor

faults.what: The big book handed across the desk carries a pseudo-text title along the top of its cover.
faults.where: top edge of the book cover, centre
faults.second_reader: confirmed: faint embossed marks on the top of the cover, minor

faults.what: Small hand-written glyph marks are scattered under the glowing sun on the map.
faults.where: just below and left of the sun, upper centre

faults.what: The old book being handed to the boy has a dark block of pseudo-text on its cover.
faults.second_reader: confirmed: small dark block on the cover, minor

faults.what: Under the book the teacher's hand and the boy's hand run together into one long hand with no clear fingers between them.
faults.must_fix_reason: The joined hands are at the centre of the picture, right under the book the shot is about.

faults.what: The boy wears a purple polo shirt and khaki trousers instead of the white school uniform he wears in every other school shot.
faults.must_fix_reason: The boy is half of this two-shot and wears a purple polo and khaki trousers, so he does not read as the uniformed boy of the shots before and after.

faults.what: The boy next to Lolo looks like a teenager, with brown hair and a blue shirt, not the ten-year-old with neat black hair from the other shots.
faults.must_fix_reason: The boy fills the right third of the frame and reads as a teenager in a blue shirt with brown hair, a different person from the ten-year-old.

faults.what: Lolo is drawn far older and gaunter, with long stringy hair and no moustache, unlike the smiling grandfather in k12, k54 and k90.
faults.second_reader: confirmed: stays minor; Lolo also changes face in k13, k18, k44 and k45 (see new entries)

faults.what: Usman has a white muzzle, white paws and both ears flat out to the sides, with the red kerchief tied round his head, not his neck.
faults.must_fix_reason: The dog is the centre of the frame and the red kerchief is tied as a bow on top of his head, with a white muzzle and white paws, so he reads as another dog.

faults.what: Indio's indigo tattoos appear on M's fingers and the back of her hands.
faults.where: both hands around the medallion, lower half
faults.must_fix_reason: The tattooed hands fill the frame in this close-up of M, so the wrong tattoos are the first thing seen.

faults.what: A hand at the corner is just a thumb-like blob with an oversized white nail and no fingers.
faults.must_fix_reason: The fist with the white slab of a nail is plain on a paused frame; moving the crop up a little removes it.

faults.what: Below the red handkerchief the fingers break up into angular shards instead of four fingers.
faults.must_fix_reason: Both of the hero's hands hang in view in a front-on shot and both palms break into cracked shards (the left corner hand too, which was not listed).

faults.what: The lowered hand's fingers dissolve into broken angular lines with no countable fingers.
faults.must_fix_reason: The palm of the lowered hand is drawn as cracked shards and is clear on a paused frame; a small reframe hides it.

faults.what: In the hook shot Indio lifts the stone with two solid red gloves that have no separate fingers, where he should have bare hands with a red handkerchief on the left wrist, and his right forearm has no tattoos.
faults.where: both hands on the stone, centre, and the bare right forearm

faults.what: The three who step out of the portal are not the cast: the young man wears a beige jacket over a blue shirt with no topknot, the woman has purple hair, a short navy coat and a shoulder bag, and the dog has two upright ears and no white chest.
faults.where: the three figures, centre and lower centre

faults.what: Indio stands as a cut-out on an empty white background with no lens and no schoolyard, so the frame looks unfinished next to the painted scenes around it.
Both of Indio's arms carry full tattoo sleeves, where only the right forearm should be tattooed.
A red cloth hangs over Indio's shoulder instead of the handkerchief on his left wrist, and both forearms are tattooed.
faults.where: shoulder at image left and both forearms

faults.what: A large wrinkled hand rests on Lolo's shoulder from outside the frame with no body it could belong to, the boy he whispers to is missing, and Lolo is drawn pale and sharp-faced in a heavier comic line than his other shots.
faults.where: left edge, on Lolo's shoulder, and his face

faults.what: The tattoo sits on Indio's left upper arm, the same arm as the handkerchief, and his forearms are bare.
A clear glass-like band floats across Lolo's nose and mouth with nothing holding it, and the boy behind wears a tie and a shirt with letters and holds a tablet.
faults.where: across the face, upper centre, and the boy at right

faults.what: Lolo has blue-grey eyes, heavy brows and a goatee here, unlike the brown-eyed grandfather of k12 and k90.
Lolo wears thin round glasses and has blue-grey hair in this shot only.
Lolo's eyes are light blue in this close-up, where he has dark brown eyes in k12 and k90.
Usman is drawn as a stocky flat-faced dog with human-shaped eyes and a green tint on his neck, unlike the slim pointed-face dog of k04 and k42.
Indio has a red handkerchief on both wrists, no topknot and no tattoos, and the dog beside him is a brown-black dog with two hanging ears and the kerchief tied across his back.
faults.where: both wrists and the dog, lower right

faults.what: Both of Indio's forearms are tattooed, where only the right should be.
The shop signs on the street behind the girls carry rows of pseudo-text.
faults.where: yellow, red and green signs, upper centre

faults.what: Three hands push the tin under the stone: one at the pole on the left and two that overlap on the right, one of them with a single long pointing finger.
The hand that reaches for Usman is pale and tattooed on the fingers and the back of the hand, and a second arm at the corner has cream and orange tattoos, none of which match Indio.
faults.where: bottom edge, centre and left corner

faults.what: Usman has a third ear: a dark folded flap grows above his upright left ear, beside a second upright ear.
Indio has no handkerchief on either wrist and no tattoos.
faults.where: both arms of the young man, right

faults.what: The young man in the foreground wears a dark jacket and shows no topknot, and the marker M should point at is a blank metal box with a slot.
faults.where: foreground left and the box at lower centre

faults.what: The young man in the foreground wears a black suit jacket with a white collar instead of the grey t-shirt.
